note: RULING 18 (Prompt C item 2). Every Kelly field's hunt state, per candidate. FOUND means the field is present with its source recorded. NOT_HUNTED means no completed hunt. VERIFIED_ABSENT means a completed hunt walked every applicable rung and the thing does not exist, and it carries those rungs and the date checked — it is earned by a hunt session and NEVER by a migration, which is why this file contains none of it. A contest renders candidate cards only when no field anywhere in it is NOT_HUNTED.
